assumptions: Take-level notes, photographs, and approved department values will be recorded during photography.
Wardrobe and makeup states are not supplied and require department confirmation before matched coverage.
Planet implementation and the final reflection and clean-pass strategy remain unconfirmed.
continuity_strategy: Track Ninel's breath, chamber position, monitor test, shown axis turn, and planet reveal across coverage and clean passes while preserving the reflection anomaly as unresolved.

items.tracked_state: Ninel opens her eyes without breathing and begins her voluntary inhale when the countdown reaches seven after frost moves.
items.required_transition: The inhale and subsequent rise in S01-SH002 continue from the choice established in S01-SH001.
items.reset_instruction: Log the eye-open, frost-movement, countdown, inhale, and rise sequence and restore its starting state.

items.tracked_state: The chamber-glass frost pattern seen close remains identifiable in the wider view.
items.required_transition: Visible frost coverage and its pre-inhale movement state match between the two shots.
items.reset_instruction: Photograph the approved frost pattern and restore the glass and frost start state.

items.tracked_state: Ninel remains seated at the chamber edge with her right hand planted through the reflection beat.
items.required_transition: Her body, hand placement, and head angle carry from S01-SH002 into the monitor insert and passes.
items.reset_instruction: Record the seated pose, right hand, shoulders, and head angle and restore them before matched coverage.

items.tracked_state: Ninel finds the monitor, turns away, and tests whether the reflected gaze continues after her movement.
items.required_transition: The insert begins from the gaze and head relationship established in S01-SH002 without making the anomaly objectively true.
items.reset_instruction: Log the real gaze, head turn, held stillness, and corresponding reflection-pass start states.

items.tracked_state: Monitor coverage includes matched performance, clean monitor, and reflection states under the established setup.
items.required_transition: The delayed reflection and clearing align with Ninel's action while retaining perceptual ambiguity.
items.reset_instruction: Restore and log camera, monitor, lighting, performer, head-angle, and eyeline states before every pass.

items.tracked_state: Ninel moves from the monitor relationship to the observation-slit relationship through a visible body turn.
items.required_transition: S01-SH004 continues from her half-turned state and shows the reorientation rather than presenting an axis jump.
items.reset_instruction: Log the ending orientation in S01-SH002 and the start, path, and end orientation in S01-SH004.

items.tracked_state: Emergency light pulses across the bay; planet light grows behind Ninel during Argo's pause in S01-SH004.
items.required_transition: Emergency state matches across coverage while planet light changes only with the final turn and reveal.
items.reset_instruction: Log the approved pulse and planet-reveal states and restore the applicable start state for each take and pass.

items.tracked_state: Ninel questions Argo, follows the changing light, and completes her turn as the planet appears before Argo says failure.
items.required_transition: Her turn, camera arc, ship rotation, planet reveal, pause, and final line preserve this story order.
items.reset_instruction: Log performer, camera, slit, planet, dialogue, and reveal start/end states and restore them before matched takes.

items.tracked_state: Countdown and inhale lead to chamber release and room hum; hum thins during the insert; Argo's pause precedes rotation and answer.
items.required_transition: Dialogue, breath, release, hum, pause, and rotation retain story order without a sting confirming the anomaly.
items.reset_instruction: Log each approved sound cue and room state by take and restore controllable practical noise before matched recording.
